title: Staff Training Programmes to Help Local Micro Businesses Offset Increased Manpower Costs Due To PWM
what_it_is: Staff Training Programmes to Help Local Micro Businesses Offset Increased Manpower Costs Due To PWM

sections.label: PWM and Workfare Skills Support
sections.summary: PWM raises lower-wage workers' wages and progression, and WSS gives employers absentee payroll of up to 95% of basic hourly salary, capped at $13 per hour.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: PWM uplifts lower-wage workers through sustainable wage increases, as well as career and training progression pathways to raise their value add to employers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Under the Workfare Skills Support (WSS), all employers, including micro businesses, who send eligible lower-wage workers for such training may receive absentee payroll of up to 95% of the trainee's basic hourly salary, capped at $13 per hour.

sections.label: Progressive Wage Credit Scheme co-funding
sections.summary: PWCS co-funds wage increases for eligible lower-wage workers: up to 75% in 2022 and 2023, up to 50% in 2024, 30% in 2025 and 15% in 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To help employers adjust to PWM wage increases, the Government has introduced the Progressive Wage Credit Scheme (PWCS), which co-funds wage increases given to eligible lower-wage workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Wage increases were co-funded up to 75% in 2022 and 2023, and up to 50% in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For 2025 and 2026, PWCS will co-fund eligible wage increases by 30% and 15% respectively.

sections.label: Industry Transformation Maps for micro businesses
sections.summary: MTI and Enterprise Singapore engage micro businesses and SMEs through ITMs on tapping Government schemes such as the Productivity Solutions Grant to transform and help workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the first question, when it comes to micro businesses and businesses in general affected by PWM and other schemes, there are the Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs) through which the Ministry of Trade and Industry and Enterprise Singapore are actively engaging many of our micro businesses, small and medium enterprises (SMEs) on how to tap on the Government schemes, whether it is the Productivity Solutions Grant or other schemes that are relevant for them, to enable them to transform and help workers.

sections.label: Enabling Employment Credit support
sections.summary: The Enabling Employment Credit provides support or defrays up to 20% of an employee's salary for persons with disabilities or others who require help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: At the same time, I just want to assure the Member as well that there are schemes, such as the Enabling Employment Credit, which provides support or even defrays the cost of up to 20% of an employee's salary if they are persons with disabilities or others who require help.
